╭──────────────────────── Classic is being deprecated ─────────────────────────╮
│                                                                              │
│    Kiro CLI is consolidating around the terminal UI (TUI), which provides    │
│      interactive menus, live activity tracking, cleaner rendering, and       │
│    accessibility settings. With the Kiro CLI 3.0 release in October, the     │
│      Classic experience will be deprecated. Drop --agent-engine v1 and       │
│            --legacy-ui to start using the TUI today. Learn more:             │
│                        https://kiro.dev/docs/cli/v3/                         │
│                                                                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
